dolomites.why: I used your overview verbatim. On the lifts: the research says you are partly right. Seceda's lifts are on booked 30-minute slots in 2026. I rewrote April, May, June to September, October and November with that. I could not find season dates for Sass Pordoi, Lagazuoi or Marmolada, so I made no claim about them.
